_comment: Locked production CameraRig stands from the established F10 matrix. Positions/focus XZ are metres; y offsets are relative to the production terrain. The rig follows the trainer, so resolved camera transforms are recorded per frame. Clock pins test invariance, not day/night presentation. Reuse unchanged for every round.

views._why_reframed: Coordinator ruling 25 Oct 2026 (F41#5 near-lens occluders): reframed with the same subject, focus and purpose; old and new kept here; judged before/after on the NEW stand only (fair pair). Chosen from CPU previews of two to three sideways offsets per stand. Old stand put a TwistedTree trunk 5-7 m from the lens at the right edge (r11-r15 judges: 'near-lens ghost trunk').

_custom_views_comment: The matrix's three extra stands, passed to capture_stormwood_f10_matrix.gd as --custom=id@pos.x,pos.z@focus.x,focus.y,focus.z@pitch (pos.y is unused there; the y offset belongs to the focus). Reframed forest/giant are passed the same way (ids forest_r, giant_r) because the tool's built-in forest/giant keep the old seats.
